verses.34:52: وَقَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانِۭ بَعِيدࣲ‏

meaning: The root NWSH primarily means to take, reach, or obtain something, often with the hand or mouth. It can also imply clinging to something or making someone attain good or evil.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
